quarterly_data.quarter: Anritsu press release: Anritsu Enables Evaluation of Wi-Fi 8 and Bluetooth LE (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: Anritsu has developed and launched new RF characteristics evaluation options for Wi-Fi 8 (IEEE 802.11bn) and Bluetooth Low Energy for its Wireless Connectivity Test Set MT8862A, supplied as software so existing MT8862A users can add Wi-Fi 8 and Bluetooth LE evaluation without a new measurement system; the platform supports Wi-Fi 8 / Wi-Fi 7 requirements including 320 MHz channel bandwidth and 4096-QAM, all three Wi-Fi 6E bands and legacy 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, in conducted and Over-the-Air testing. The company says Wi-Fi 8 is being developed toward formal standardization in 2028, with adoption expected in AI-enabled equipment including physical AI systems such as robots.
